exposure: maternal excess body mass index (BMI) before gestation
outcome: Perinatal outcomes (childbirth weight, preterm birth, newborn ponderal index, caesarean section delivery)
Postnatal outcomes (diabetes type 1, childhood overweight/obesity at pre-school age)
cohort: 5198 children aged 2-5 years old and their paired mothers
finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity was independently associated with a higher risk of childhood overweight/obesity at pre-school age, as well as with a higher incidence of childbirth weight, caesarean section delivery, and diabetes type 1.
mod_finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity was associated with a higher incidence of caesarean section delivery.
